source_xy_policy: Retain source columns, rows, cell values and turn sequence.
neighborhood: Wins use straight axis, face-diagonal and space-diagonal lines; adjacency does not govern placement.
movement: No movement; place the current mark in an unoccupied cell.
outcomes: Three matching marks on a straight length-three line win; otherwise a full volume draws.
presentation: One centered orthogonal volume retaining source mark colours, cell appearance, font and status.
input: Select a volume cell to place; route R and Escape to host restart and quit.
z_equals_one_tests: Horizontal, vertical and both diagonal wins match the source on a one-layer board.
Occupied and out-of-bounds cells reject placement.
z_gt_one_tests: A fixed-x,y line through all depth layers wins.
Moves after a win reject; host restart remains available.
alternatives: One depth layer reproduces the source but does not provide spatial play.
A larger volume changes the source’s three-cell extents.
